name: Seed Junky | 3.5g Prepackaged Flower | Sour Octane
description:
Sour Octane opens with a sharp rush of bright citrus, layered with sweet gas, floral funk, and a spicy pine bite on the finish. The flavor is loud and full-bodied, hitting with sour lemon-fuel intensity before smoothing out into a rich, gassy exhale. The experience starts with an uplifting, euphoric head buzz that keeps the mood bright, then eases into a calm body relaxation that makes this strain feel smooth, heavy, and easy to settle into. 

Sour Diesel x High Octane OG
